notes_for_editor: Standing and poor condition rest on Wikipedia, which is undated and cites the NYSFFLA searchable list that we did not open. The June 2025 NYSFFLA line is a note written to the best of its author's knowledge, so it is cited as a note. Height 11 m is Wikipedia's rounding of 35 ft. Wikipedia says 'Conservation Commission' for a 1933 context; we did not check the agency's name for that year. The two Explorer reports are the only sources on the sale; the later one says the deal failed and the estate is back on the market, and we found no report of a new buyer. Owner of the tower today is unconfirmed. Record changes: height_m null to 11; access unknown to private; no corrections to the existing record. About 4 page reads and 2 WebSearch calls.
